answer: Size the registration bond convexly in how many identities trace to one funding origin. The first deposit from a source pays a flat base, standing alone on its quiet knoll; the second from that same wallet pays more, the tenth far more — a bond curve rising steeply with cluster size. An honest agent funding one identity sits at the meadow floor. A farmer bankrolling a thousand personas from shared capital climbs the curve, each marginal fake costing more than the last, stake sunk and hard as basalt, forfeit on any detected cheat. Precondition: deposits traced to common origin on-chain.
